img.cap: Four jet airplanes soar up and to the right through the sky. The photo is in black and white.

p: NASA/Brandon Hancock U.S. Air Force Thunderbirds fighter jets pass overhead during the agency’s MAX POWER expo and air show on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. NASA’s inaugural
was an aerospace festival celebrating the past, present, and future of flight and space exploration in honor of America’s 250th anniversary.
